label: lem-straight-line-homotopies-are-continuous
tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN
BOUNDARY: Empty space (X empty) yields empty product, so all maps are vacuously continuous. Degenerate cases (f = g, C a singleton) and endpoints (t = 0, t = 1) are handled by the same formulas without alteration. n = 1 works because the coordinate index k < 1 is k = 0, and the vector algebra still applies. The proof does not require X to be metric, uses no choice principle, and does not divide by zero or rely on any hidden assumptions.

Every use (L1–L5) is supported by the quoted statements or by immediate consequences of them.
CHECKED: The title, the public claim, every numbered proof step (1.1 through 5.1), and the Remarks were read and verified.
